newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse extends Ban Chang share trading range.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse extends Ban Chang share trading range.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand has given shares of troubled Thai property developer Ban Chang Plc a 100 percent daily trading limit when the price of the stock at the previous close is less than one baht.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand said the decision would allow trading to reflect sentiment towards the stock. The company's shares closed at 0.90 baht on February 19.
